admission_price: General Admission starting at $35.00 + tax; FastPass starting at $45.00 + tax. Additional activities priced separately: Corn Maze $10.00 per person, Zombie Gellyball Shootout $10.00, Graveyard Games $5 per game, Escape Room $10.00. VIP Parking $10.00 per vehicle.

Security on site; police presence on busy nights. Not handicap accessible (outdoor event on natural terrain). Online ticket purchase recommended.
